column3: “Answered and said” is rendered “answered.”
“Comforters of trouble” is rendered “Sorry comforters.”
“Plagues” renders a word that may mean “provokes.”
NASB uses “could”; “make join on you in words” is rendered “compose words against you.”
NASB supplies “your pain.”
“I will cease” is rendered “if I hold back.”
The Hebrew moves from “he” to “you”; NASB keeps both.
“Seized” is rendered “shriveled”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Assailed” is rendered “hunted me down,” and “sharpens his eyes” as “glares.”
NASB supplies “on the cheek.”
“An unjust one” is rendered “ruffians.”
“Smashed” is rendered “shattered.”
“His archers” is rendered “His arrows”; the meaning of the Hebrew word is uncertain.
“A breach on the face of a breach” is rendered “breach after breach.”
“Inserted” is rendered “thrust.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“On not” is rendered “Although there is no.”
“A place” is rendered “a resting place.”
The second “witness” is rendered “advocate.”
“Scoffing at me are my companions” is rendered “My friends are my scoffers”; the Hebrew may mean “my interpreter,” and the meaning is uncertain.
“A child of humankind for his companion” is rendered “As a man with his neighbor.”
“Years of number” is rendered “a few years,” and NASB supplies “are past.”
